dedupe_keys.name: european climate risk assessment eucra interactive viewers major risks and impact drivers

description: These two interactive viewers present key findings of the first European Climate Risk Assessment (EUCRA), published by the European Environment Agency in 2024. The major risks viewer gives an overview of the major climate risks to Europe by urgency, severity, time horizon and policy ownership and shows how they link to exposed EU policy areas. The impact drivers viewer shows observed and projected climatic and non-climatic impact drivers affecting the different regions of Europe. Both are hosted free online on the Climate-ADAPT platform of the EEA and the European Commission, alongside the full EUCRA report. Caveats: risk ratings are expert judgements, not model outputs, the viewers summarise, not supply gridded data, and the assessment reflects the evidence available in 2024. It supports scoping of infrastructure climate risks and choosing hazards and time horizons for European resilience studies; a related record is the Climate Impact Explorer.
